title: We built a platform to help mobile devs build community before launch, would love feedback from devs.
author: varunkumarnr
selftext:
We are indie game devs with multiple games release some hits, many flops.

We've spent the last few months building something I've wished existed while making mobile games.

One thing We've always found frustrating is that mobile developers have great tools **after** launch, but very little support **before** it.

So We built **PixelPicked** a curated pre-launch OS for mobile games.

The idea is simple: support developers from their first prototype all the way to launch day.  
  
It includes:

* Curated game pages
* Devlogs
* Build Wishlists notify everyone on launch
* Browser-playable HTML builds
* Playtester recruitment
* Auto analytics - session, retention, FPS, crashes, heatmaps. No SDK, no code setup needed.
* dynamic smart Feedback collection
* Weekly launch campaign events
* Likes, comments, and community features, feature in newletter

The goal is to reduce the cost of validating a game idea as early as possible at zero cost.

Attached a short walkthrough of the current version. Would genuinely love feedback from other mobile devs.

IF your working on a game or looking for quality upcoming and live games check us out will Appricate it.

Attaching video too.
